notes.title: Huge Thanks + What's Next for Dread Not
notes.content:
[p]Hello Everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Over [b]150,000[/b] people have Added Dread Not to their library, with almost [b]25,000[/b] lifetime player.[/p][p][/p][p]I want to start off with a message to everyone who has played our game...  From the bottom of all of our hearts, thank you! [/p][p][/p][p]When we began this project for our senior capstone game, we knew we had something special. We had no idea however, that just 7 months later, we would be on the front page of users' Opera GX browsers, and that so many people would acquire, and play our game.[/p][p]

As an audience, you have been invaluable to us, from all the feedback, the bug reporting, and encouragement, it's been a pleasure to experience having a community and interacting with all of you. 

I want to spend the rest of this announcement discussing what is next for this game, as well as what is next for us as a team. 

Dread Not is far from finished, we released the game in early access to get as many eyes (that were not ours) on the game as possible, to get outside perspective from individuals and to apply that feedback to the game. 

Dread Not did release in a quite compromising state, it didn't run well, it had a lot of visual and technical bugs that were quite frankly, game breaking. Having the ability to read these reports in real time gave us the ability to quickly identify and fix several issues already, and is continuing to be invaluable to us as developers. 

We have a small, very rough roadmap for you to indulge in, to get a good idea of the remaining release cycle of the game.

Sprinkled through the coming weeks and months[/p][p]- Continued fixes for any visual and technical bugs players encounter[/p][p]- Continued Graphics and Memory/CPU optimizations[/p][p]- Continued Inclusion of new audio[/p][p]- Continued work on environmental juice![/p][p][/p][p]Update 0.2 - July[/p][p]Will include Collectible Lore Objects for the players to find and read in their own time.[/p][p]Will include some accessibility features regarding puzzles[/p][p]Will include one new puzzle for players to interact with[/p][p]Will include an update to the player indicator to update at all times[/p][p]Will include further optimization regarding memory, CPU Usage as well as GPU usage[/p][p][/p][p]Update 0.3 - Late July/August[/p][p]Will include one new puzzle for players to interact with[/p][p]Will include further optimizations regarding memory, CPU Usage[/p][p]Will include a slight rework to the C02 system, will include a rework of torpedoes[/p][p]Will include some solo objectives for the mechanic to complete and interact with[/p][p][/p][p]Beyond Update 0.3
Will include one or more new puzzles for players to interact with
Will create a single player survival horror mode for players to experience
Will rework the tutorial to the best of our abilities to give players a better idea of the game
More features to come throughout updates 0.4 - 1.0


[b]When do we plan on releasing?
[/b]The big question, as of right now the goal is to have all the content we want in the game by the end of November or Early December, most of us are moving on to bigger and better project so it will take us this time to finalize Dread Not. 

[b]What's next for the team? [/b][/p][p]We absolutely adored working with each other here at Leviathan Interactive through this process, but given that this studio was formed for our capstone project, most of us have moved on to other ventures. As we all begin our new lives/careers as game developers, some members of the team will share their journeys with you in case you're curious and want to see us grow.    [/p][p][/p][p]We loved making Dread Not, we still love making Dread Not, and we will always love our time on this game. 

Thank you for downloading, and playing Dread Not. Until the dev cycle for this game ends, we will cherish every comment, every review, every piece of feedback you may give. 


- Tech Director Ben[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.4
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Some Changes we have for you include

[list]
[*] A rework of how in-puzzle interaction is calculated, this should fix the light puzzle activating twice and also occasional stuttering on poor frame-rate
[*] More graphics optimization
[*] Started re-allocating in-engine resources to start lowering memory usage, it's not much of a reduction but we will continue in any way we can to free up memory for players.
[*] Tweaked some locations for sound objects for playing them in more respectable locations.
[/list]

Just a small update this time around, however, we have somewhat of a plan moving forward for feature releases.

Sprinkled through the coming weeks and months
- Continued fixes for any visual and technical bugs players encounter
- Continued Graphics and Memory/CPU optimizations
- Continued Inclusion of new audio
- Continued work on environmental juice!

Update 0.2 - July
Will include Collectible Lore Objects for the players to find and read in their own time.
Will include some accessibility features regarding puzzles
Will include one new puzzle for players to interact with
Will include an update to the player indicator to update at all times
Will include further optimization regarding memory, CPU Usage as well as GPU usage

Update 0.3 - Late July/August
Will include one new puzzle for players to interact with
Will include further optimizations regarding memory, CPU Usage
Will include a slight rework to the C02 system, will include a rework of torpedoes
Will include some solo objectives for the mechanic to complete and interact with

 That's all we have for now, in the future beyond 0.3, we hope to include one more map, a single player survival horror prequel, steam achievements, more objectives, and more!

Tech Director Ben.

notes.title: Patch Notes 6/20/2025
notes.content:
Small Stuff for today

Fixed an issue where after you complete a game you would not be able to join or start another match 
Fixed a visual issue with the wire puzzle solutions as the pilot (showed more than one set of cables)

Currently working on an issue where the light puzzle in the comms room is hard to interact with, due to the light switch changing it's state twice on one click. 

Will test the fix I am working on for the light puzzle (and eventually all puzzles) later today.


[b]Plans for the next big update[/b]
- Updating the actual location of the mechanic in real time for the pilot to see
- Adding more sounds and adjusting locations and attenuation to make more sense
- Reworking interaction system with puzzles to allow for less bugs to occur
- Adding more sounds and environmental juice to the game
- Adding random events that will occur on the submarine
- Adding some environmental pieces to interact with 
- Fixing an issue with grabbable objects where they cause the player character to um...dance?
- Fixing walk audio bug with the mechanic
- Adding voice chat audio sliders
- Further visual optimization for improved performance


- Ben

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.1.3
notes.content:
Hey Again!

[list]
[*]Added an indication on whether or not a game is public or private
[*]Added a back button to the password creation and entering to give you another chance at joining another game or creating another game.
[/list]

As always, it's a pleasure reading feedback, a quick update on known issues we are working to address
[list]
[*]Ping shows up as 9999, this is because unreal has no native support for ping on listen servers, we are going to work on a custom fix for this, in the meantime ping will show up as 9999
[*] Players selecting the same character at the same time will still cause issues with starting the game. We are still working on a fix for this. 
[*] We've become aware of an issue with the mouse disappearing upon interacting with certain object, we are working on diagnosing this issue.
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback! As always we love to see it, 

Here is our discord again! [url=https://discord.gg/hBKKtW2ay3]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2, the one that includes wires
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here again so soon?

I have a pretty significant change for all of you!

[list]
[*] Added visual confirmation of connecting wires within the tutorial wire puzzle, and two wire puzzles. 
[/list]

Visual confirmation just means that you will see the wire in real time, to confirm that you have interacted with the puzzle correctly, and rather than changing our system to a drag click, you can click like normal and get just as much visual feedback!

That's all for Today! See you soon with more!

Discord - [url=https://discord.gg/hBKKtW2ay3]Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thanks for bearing with us as we iron out some of the release kinks... This updates has a few things to talk about.

But first...We have a discord community server!

Join here with your ideas for the game, support, and general feedback! [url=https://discord.gg/hBKKtW2ay3]https://discord.gg/hBKKtW2ay3[/url]

Additions
[list]
[*] We added the ability to create your match as a private match, or a public match. Meaning that someone can join your game without needing to know you, or the password. 
[*] 
[*] We added voice chat! Voice chat is automatically enabled for players upon joining the game. Just start talking and get to playing!
[*] 
[*] We added Difficulty! You can choose the difficulty of your game on the 'create game' page
[*]
[/list]
FIXES
[list]
[*] We fixed an issue with the search bar not working for lobbies, right now it is CASE SENSITIVE as with everything in the game thus far. 
[*]
[*] We fixed an issue where entering your password would not indicate really that you joined a lobby, so we added a loading throbber to the screen
[*]
[/list]
KNOWN ISSUES
[list]
[*] We are aware of an issue players are having where selecting a character at the same time as another person winds up with not being able to start the game. We are working on a fix for this issue.
[*] We are aware of an issue players are having where some of the puzzles are not working as intended on some playthroughs. 
[/list]
FUTURE (Technical) UPDATES
[list]
[*]Voice chat will be a setting that you will be able to enable and disable for a match. 
[*]We intend to fix the issue with players selecting at the same time ASAP, for now, proceed with caution on the select screen!
[*]Being able to choose your input device on the settings screen
[/list]

Thank you so much for trying our game! It's fun to receive feedback from yall...hope to hear more from all of you going forward!

notes.title: Release! And News!
notes.content:
[p][b]Good Evening!

Tech Director Ben here with some upcoming updates to the game being worked on...[/b]

1. Difficulty sliders are coming soon!

[i]- Novice (Easy)
- Junior (Medium)
- Senior (Hard)
- Veteran (Impossible)[/i]

2. The ability to make a match public or private is coming soon!
[i]This allows for play with random players, we are hoping to launch this with the introduction of voice chat to allow for random players to interact with one another![/i]

3. Voice chat will be coming soon! It's proving to be much more of a difficult process than we had initially realized...
[i]Voice chat will allow you to not require discord for communication! Yippee![/i]


[b]Known Bugs -[/b] 
We are aware of an issue where you may be unable to join a game once you exit a match. This is currently a top level priority with a fix coming soon

We are aware of an issue with the refresh button being disabled, and having to search and then press refresh. This is a top level priority with a fix coming in the next update

Lastly, we are aware of an issue with the emote for the mechanic locking both player inputs. This is getting fixed in the next update.

We are going to release a roadmap soon with new features you can expect![/p]
